sn38.6:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso paramassāsapatto hotī ti || ||
sn38.6:1.3: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channam phassāyatānānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañ ca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti || ettāvatā kho āvuso paramassāsapatto hotī ti || || 4
sn38.6:1.4: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn38.6:1.5: Atthi kho āvuso atthi paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 5
sn38.6:1.6: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn38.6:1.7: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāya || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn38.6:1.9: ayaṃ eva kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 6
sn38.6:1.10: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa paramassāsassa sacchikiriyāya ||
